purpose: Resolves BF-1/AG-M2-2/AG-M2-3: after Option E's CREATEROLE narrowing (v1.0.2), db:migrate:local still failed because uellix_owner has no privilege to CREATE the drizzle bookkeeping schema, no CREATE on schema public, no USAGE on schema auth, and migration 0039 needs two functions (Part A of unit 41) that no governed disposable step yet creates. This authority closes all four gaps with the SMALLEST possible temporary/permanent grant set, entirely inside this disposable, non-persistent fixture. v1.0.2 remains in force and unmodified; this authority is strictly additive.

hpo_decisions_frozen.SCOPE: This fixture-only privilege window applies EXCLUSIVELY inside a disposable, non-persistent PostgreSQL container this same script creates and tears down. It does not define, modify, or claim to represent hosted, local-development, staging, or production role topology.

authorized_pre_migration_sequence.name: PLATFORM_ROLE_PACKAGE

Require its own self-verification PASS. No fragment extraction, no modification.

authorized_pre_migration_sequence.name: GOVERNED_OWNER_PUBLIC_SCHEMA_CAPABILITY
authorized_pre_migration_sequence.action: GRANT CREATE ON SCHEMA public TO uellix_owner;
authorized_pre_migration_sequence.classification: PERMANENT_FOR_THIS_FIXTURE — matches the governed local owner topology (db/prepared/stella_0001_role_topology_bootstrap.sql:176); NOT revoked at the end of M2.

authorized_pre_migration_sequence.name: GOVERNED_OWNER_AUTH_SCHEMA_USAGE
authorized_pre_migration_sequence.action: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA auth TO uellix_owner;
authorized_pre_migration_sequence.classification: THE ONLY privilege-changing statement this gate may execute as supabase_admin. No other GRANT/REVOKE/ALTER/CREATE/DROP/ownership operation may run as supabase_admin. Read-only verification as supabase_admin is allowed. The script must assert this one-write-operation invariant mechanically. No postgres fallback for this specific statement.

authorized_pre_migration_sequence.name: CORPUS_PREREQUISITE_PART_A
authorized_pre_migration_sequence.action: Apply the COMPLETE, unmodified db/prepared/storage/20260716000001_part_a_helpers.psql.sql (SHA256 verified against the pin above before execution) in one continuous psql/session context, authenticated as session_user=uellix_migrator with active current_user=uellix_owner (via SET ROLE, verified to have taken effect before the file executes — fail closed otherwise). No fragment extraction, no Part B, no full Supabase migration, no file modification. Establishes control PRIV-P7: public.can_read_evidence_object(text,uuid) and public.can_write_evidence_object(text,uuid) both exist and are owned by uellix_owner before db:migrate:local runs.
